name: Meridian Tactical Solutions NightCap Hood
description:
A pull-over hood made from signal-dampening fabric that blocks most passive scanning frequencies. The NightCap covers the head, neck, and lower face, leaving only a narrow eye slit backed by anti-glare mesh. It is not armor — it is invisibility from the electromagnetic spectrum.

Runners, data thieves, and anyone crossing a surveilled zone without authorization consider the NightCap essential kit. It won't stop a bullet, but it will stop a facial-recognition drone from tagging you.
functionality: RF signal blocking, facial recognition defeat, thermal signature reduction
what_it_says: You don't exist on camera and you'd like to keep it that way.
story_hooks: A warehouse raid recovers 500 NightCap hoods, all tagged with serial numbers — someone was selling anonymity while secretly tracking every buyer.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, form-fitting pull-over hood that envelops the entire head and neck in matte darkness. The silhouette is angular and severe—a featureless obsidian mask interrupted only by a horizontal eye slit that glints with faint iridescent mesh. Worn, it renders the wearer's identity abstract and unknowable.
physical_description.fit: Compression-tight against the scalp and neck, conforming to head contours without bunching. The fabric stretches elastically but holds its shape, leaving minimal gaps at edges. The eye slit is precisely positioned to align with most human eye heights.
physical_description.primary_material: Signal-dampening synth-weave composite—a proprietary blend of conductive mesh interlaced with electromagnetic-absorbing fibers. Surface has subtle iridescence from embedded metamaterial threads.
physical_description.texture: Smooth to the touch with a faint grip texture, almost tacky against skin. The eye-slit mesh has a fine, almost imperceptible weave that creates a barely-visible grid pattern when backlit.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep matte black with minimal contrast. The eye-slit mesh glints dark gunmetal gray under direct light. No visible branding or patterns—pure functional darkness.
physical_description.closures: None—fully pull-over design with elastic tension at the base of the neck. No zippers, snaps, or adjustable straps to compromise the seal.
distinctive_features: Signal-dampening weave rated for most passive scanning frequencies
Precision-cut horizontal eye slit with anti-glare mesh backing
Coverage extends from crown to lower face and full neck
Seamless construction with no external seams or edges
Subtle Meridian Tactical Solutions embossed marker inside back of neck (invisible when worn)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 crossover: luxury for street operatives. Expensive enough to signal serious intent, accessible to well-funded runners and mid-tier corporate security.
physical_description.cultural_context: The uniform of the invisible. Worn by data runners, black-market couriers, unauthorized traversers of corporate surveillance zones, and anyone operating outside institutional gaze. Signals expertise, caution, and criminal intent—or paranoia depending on context. Associated with the underground economy.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new, but quickly shows micro-creasing and minor discoloration from sweat and wear. The eye-slit mesh rarely accumulates visible dust due to the fabric's electrostatic properties. Well-maintained units show no fraying; abused ones develop small tears along the neck band.
